scope: Independent sampled-B source/configuration review. No actual M0, formal B, C, evaluation or performance admission.

checks.name: Frozen input identity and syntax
checks.evidence: All 68 registered source hashes match; the accepted formal 64 are unchanged; 67 Python files parse as Python 3.7 syntax; 78 sealed local inputs remain unchanged.

checks.name: Reuse and construction
checks.evidence: The new policy inherits the original CADTrack/SOT executor and 955-input gain head; the two scalar radius attributes add no learned parameter. The new driver calls the scale factory directly and reuses original sampling, optimizer and causal-probe helpers without monkeypatching or changing old factories.

checks.name: Initialization
checks.evidence: Before construction the driver requires registered factory ba49b506 and fitted preview ad059943 identities, the protected CADTrack hash, source/input hashes and independent source report. It strictly loads the original fitted preview, never the M0 checkpoint, for formal initialization. Checkpoint bytes were not loaded in this source review.

checks.name: Training-only sampling and budget
checks.evidence: Actual EvidencePairs NumPy sampling AST reproduced all 50,000 planned choices: all 882 train sources in each of five epochs, 32 distinct M0 sources, strictly earlier templates and finite positive-size float32 targets. Train names are disjoint from dev97/test245. Batch8 gives 6250 updates and two executed labels per sample gives the registered 100000-label budget.

checks.name: Sampled targets and family counts
checks.evidence: Both modalities sample uniformly from actual kind-matched eligible requests. Local/global families use their own requested cell and rank. Source applies original execute_boxes image clipping before main/query IoU, then subtracts query IoU minus main IoU in float32; no nonnegative clamp or GT crop clipping. Per-family eligible count, request cell, ordered-union count, raw/executed boxes and signed label are distinct logged fields. No actual NN label was generated or verified here.

checks.name: Optimization and freeze
checks.evidence: Seed2027, eval mode, no autocast/TF32, zero eight-dimensional offline history, inherited SmoothL1 quality plus mean of two modality gain losses, AdamW lr/weight_decay1e-4 and gradient clip1. Only executor.quality/query_gain parameters require gradients. M0 requires finite nonzero head gradients, real optimizer step count, 257 unchanged frozen states and exactly eight changed head states; these remain runtime assertions, not completed results.

checks.name: Saved configuration and strict reload
checks.evidence: Both checkpoint and config.json use stage scale_candidate_b and retain .25/.50/max8. The loader reads saved radii before factory construction and strictly loads saved net. Capacity is returned in config and explicitly supplied by caller; it is not a hidden model attribute. M0 compares 14 ordered tensor outputs including request cells and family counts, saved config equality and K1 legacy geometry/gain equality.

checks.name: Own-M0 formal gate
checks.evidence: The exact native command, COMPLETE/exit0/GPU1, own stage, plan/source/input/config bindings, strict reload/probe fields, freeze/change counts and ten-frame selected-output replay are checked before seed setup and model construction. Twenty-seven synthetic evaluations of the existing AST gate accept current fixtures and reject actual mismatched command/stage/config/failure conditions. These are source fixtures, not real M0 receipts.

checks.name: Causal probe and scope
checks.evidence: The reused ten-frame tracker probe receives the new model and capacity, uses frame0 initialization then prior prediction/history/templates, replays chosen STOP or one heavy query, and requires all265 model states unchanged. This is an execution probe only. The B dataset remains GT-jittered offline pairs; new C, frozen dev selection, three benchmarks and complete-system latency remain separate pending work.

checks.name: Commands and current priority
checks.evidence: CLI arguments and native command expectations are consistent with scripts/run_task.py. Command templates below are unexecuted. Existing E0/E1 training and benchmark priority is preserved; no task or observer was launched.
